h1: Buckeye On the Beach | 2288 E Co Hwy 30a
meta_description: Searching for a cozy Seaside rental? Our 4-bed, 4.5-bath Buckeye On The Beach home is perfect for families or large groups craving a luxury vacation. Book here!
description_expanded:
Buckeye On the Beach | 2288 E Co Highway 30a | Seaside, FL

Beach front home that is only steps away to Seaside town center with an all-encompassing beach retreat that is perfect for any occasion! Offering three levels of luxury, wonderful outdoor living spaces with gorgeous views, and sleeping arrangements for 10, you and your family can indulge in an unsurpassed luxury vacation!

This idyllic home offers three levels of luxury and an inverted floor plan, creating an elevated main living on the highest floor with sleeping arrangements lying on lower levels. The gorgeous third-floor living space offers ample seating for all between the separate sitting space for four and couch seating around the cozy fireplace with large, wall-mounted flat-screen TV. Being an open-concept area, you can swiftly move into the coastal chic dining space with seating for eight or utilize additional seating for five at the sleek breakfast bar. The kitchen is complete with a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Thermador appliances, and Kohler sink for all your cooking needs. The wet bar also grants you access to a subzero wine cooler and Thermador ice maker. The third floor also offers a half bath for convenient use, and directly off of the third-floor living space find the wonderful porch with plenty of outdoor seating, al fresco dining, and breathtaking views of the Emerald Coast.

The second level offers a private porch space with a view of the Gulf of Mexico which can be found directly off of the master suite. The bright master suite also features a king-sized bed, spa-like ensuite bathroom with a glass door shower, jet tub, dual vanities, and an expansive walk-in closet. On this floor, you can also find a stackable Whirpool washer/dryer in the elevated laundry space, and an additional guest bedroom offering a queen-sized bed, wall-mounted TV, and an ensuite bath. One of the best hang out spots lies right before you descend to the first floor where there are two hanging swings on the covered balcony.

The final level of the home offers a true retreat and features the spacious first floor master suite with king-sized bed, ensuite bathroom with glass-door walk-in shower. Indulge in a cup of coffee in the morning or glass of wine in the evening on the screened-in back porch found directly off of the master suite. The screened in back porch is where the family canr relax in the seating after a great day at the beach. You can even open the shutters and look over to Bud & Alley's and out to the gulf. This level also offers a convenient laundry space with side by side whirlpool washer/dryer and a bunk room with two bunk beds offering twin over twin-sized beds with ensuite bathroom.

Enjoy exploring the renowned community of Seaside on the bikes that are available with the property, and visit all the great eateries like Great Southern, Bud & Alleys, Whiskey Bravos, The Melt Down, etc. that only step away from the home! Seaside also offers wonderful boutiques for great shopping, and if you're lucky you may catch a live show in the beautiful Seaside Amphitheater. Don't let this vacation dream pass you by, book today!

**Construction noises may be present.

******************************************************

Decks on 2nd and 3rd Floors

Steps to Seaside Town Center

Elevator

4 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

First Floor

- Screened-in back porch with beautiful seating area

- Luxurious master suite with king sized bed and ensuite bathroom

- Bunk room with (2) bunk beds offering twin over twin-sized beds and ensuite bathroom

- Laundry space with side by side Whirlpool washer/dryer

Second Floor

- Master suite with king-sized bed and ensuite bath

- Guest suite with queen-sized bed and ensuite bath

- Private porch with seating and views of the Gulf

- Laundry room

Third Floor

- Entertainment area with ample seating

- Coastal chic dining space for 8 guests

- Breakfast bar with seating for 5 guests

- Wet bar

- Fully stocked kitchen with Sub-Zero and Thermador appliances

- Expansive deck space facing the water with unobstructed Gulf views

- Half-bathroom

Additional

- Parking for 2 vehicles

- Golf cart rentals are not allowed in Seaside.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet Policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- Seaside Amenity Fees Include: Seaside Parking Passes (2), Wristbands for Beach Access, and Access to the Community Swimming Pools and Tennis Courts.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancelations are given 60 days prior to arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to arrival date

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
